steering_coefficient_sweep.details: WARN: Variant inherits M3's under-validated operating region (no random-direction control, no mid-plateau established). Additionally, the sigma_proj=886 value for Qwen-14B means the four alpha points {-2,-1,+1,+2} all produce effective coefficients in [886, 1772] — well above any coherent steering region for this model. The variant correctly executes the same protocol as the main experiment (same alpha set, same sigma_proj scaling) which is appropriate for a model-swap robustness test (we deliberately apply the same formula, not a model-specific re-calibrated set). The fact that no coherent operating points exist for steering is the scientific finding — not a methodology failure.
steering_coefficient_sweep.note_on_protocol_fidelity: The variant intentionally replicates the main experiment protocol (same alpha set, same sigma_proj-scaled formula) to test whether the claim generalizes. Re-calibrating alpha for Qwen-14B would change the experiment, not test robustness. The sigma_proj=886 finding is the key result.
